
[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- main.volt:0[/yellow bold]

Variable `counter` is shared between critical task (isr_task, isr_task, isr_task) and task (slow_task). The compiler will mark it `volatile` in generated C.


[cyan]Hint: For multi-word values, consider using atomic operations.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]
